goal: Prevent blocks needed for rescan from being pruned when wallets are unloaded on pruned nodes
Allow external wallet software and indexers to keep blocks on disk without disabling pruning entirely
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Concept approval to support external wallets and indexers on pruned nodes (achow101, stickies-v, optout21)
Verified by testing an electrs indexer backed by a pruned signet node (optout21)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because external indexers and wallets need RPC controls to protect blocks from pruning
Avoids complex workarounds or disabling pruning entirely during maintenance and rescan

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it exposes existing block storage lock controls to external callers
Does not alter consensus rules or core chainstate invariants
